name: codex-oauth-provider
goal: Select and authenticate the Codex provider through daemon/runtime events rendered by the TUI, then list and use account-eligible models.
user_flow: selecting OpenAI starts ChatGPT browser OAuth when credentials are absent
the daemon emits the authorization URL and the TUI renders it
the browser redirects to the daemon callback server
the daemon exchanges the code, stores credentials, fetches models, and opens the model picker
/model lists only models exposed by the active provider

components.role: renders provider/model picker and OAuth status events
owns provider selection and login lifecycle
ChatGPT OAuth PKCE login, callback, token refresh and storage
Codex Responses SSE adapter and tool calls

edges: resolve access token and account id
mvp: daemon provider/model picker events rendered by TUI
